name: Go Rot
summary: Open your short-form feed while Codex or Claude works, then return when the agent needs you.
singlePurpose: Go Rot hands attention between a supported coding agent and the user's chosen short-form feed.

permissions.nativeMessaging: Connects to the locally installed Go Rot companion, which relays content-free Codex and Claude lifecycle events. No data is sent to a developer-operated server.
permissions.storage: Stores Go Rot settings, readiness evidence, window placement, and content-free local task state on the user's device.
permissions.scripting: After the user grants access to a selected feed, pauses or resumes that page's video and can wait for the current clip to end before returning to the agent.
permissions.system.display: Remembers the Go Rot popup's display and bounds so the same feed window returns to the user's chosen screen.
permissions.optionalHostPermissions: Requested only for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, or Instagram Reels selected by the user. Access is used locally to control the playing video and detect clip changes; Go Rot does not read page text, cookies, history, messages, likes, or comments.
